what_would_change_my_mind: The next 13F showing a reversal to net distribution among top holders.

short.rationale: 13F data is too stale to say much about the next week.

medium.rationale: Net institutional buying last quarter tends to persist for a while.

long.rationale: Rising institutional ownership is a slow-moving positive over a year.

comparison_class.definition: Names with positive QoQ institutional share change and more top-holder net buyers than net sellers, using the most recent available 13F
comparison_class.why_this_class: closest analogue for a filed-but-lagged institutional accumulation signal

key_evidence.claim: QoQ institutional share change +1.8%, 312 net buyers vs 201 net sellers among top holders

thesis: Institutional ownership rose 1.8% quarter over quarter with more top holders adding than trimming, and short interest is low relative to float with a sub-2-day days-to-cover -- no squeeze setup, but no crowded-short overhang either. This data is roughly two and a half weeks past the filing date but the underlying quarter itself is already up to three months old, so confidence is capped by that lag regardless of term.
